segments.normalizedSource: ```swift class CircleView: UIView { override func draw(_ rect: CGRect) { let ovalBounds = self.bounds.insetBy(dx: 10, dy: 10) let oval = UIBezierPath(ovalIn: ovalBounds) let brightRed = UIColor(displayP3Red: 1.0, green: 0.0, blue: 0.0, alpha: 1.0) brightRed.setFill() oval.fill() } } ```
